2607.15123.title: NIFA: Nonlinear IMC enhanced FPGA for efficient ML inference
2607.15123.paper_summary: Recent FPGAs have improved deep learning (DL) inference efficiency through dedicated tensor blocks and in-BRAM computation. ReRAM-based analog in-memory computing (IMC) pushes efficiency further, offering an order-of-magnitude improvement in compute density and energy efficiency over conventional digital logic by performing vector-matrix multiplication (VMM) directly within the ReRAM crossbar; prior work has integrated such IMC blocks into FPGAs for DL inference. However, conventional IMC designs support only static-weight VMM, leaving nonlinear operations and dynamic matrix-matrix multiplication (DIMM) to the FPGA fabric. As a result, the benefits of IMC are largely confined to static-weight models, whereas Transformer-based models, which rely on frequent nonlinear and DIMM operations, gain only limited improvement. Moreover, the ADCs within each IMC block consume more than 70% of its area and power, further limiting system efficiency and scalability. To address these limitations, we propose a novel FPGA architecture that integrates an ADC-free IMC block, replacing the conventional ADC with analog content-addressable memories (ACAMs) that natively perform nonlinear operations inside the block. To fully exploit this block, we conduct an FPGA-aware design-space exploration that determines optimal crossbar dimensions while balancing FPGA area, flexibility, and DL performance, and we develop an efficient mapping that leverages ACAMs to carry out DIMM operations, extending the applicability of IMC to attention computation. On CNN and Transformer-based benchmarks, the proposed architecture achieves up to 40x and 1.9x higher energy efficiency and 4.1x and 2.5x higher area efficiency, respectively. Overall, it significantly improves FPGA DL inference efficiency and sustains robust gains on Transformer-based workloads across long input sequences, advancing domain-specialized FPGA design.
2607.15123.paper_summary_zh: 最近的FPGA透過專用的張量區塊和內部BRAM計算改善了深度學習（DL）推理效率。基於ReRAM的類比內存計算（IMC）進一步提升了效率，通過在ReRAM交叉開關內直接執行向量-矩陣乘法（VMM），提供了比傳統數位邏輯高出一個數量級的計算密度和能量效率；先前的工作已將這種IMC區塊整合到FPGA中以進行DL推理。然而，傳統的IMC設計僅支持靜態權重VMM，將非線性運算和動態矩陣-矩陣乘法（DIMM）留給FPGA架構。因此，IMC的好處主要限於靜態權重模型，而基於Transformer的模型依賴於頻繁的非線性和DIMM運算，僅獲得有限的改進。此外，每個IMC區塊內的ADC消耗了超過70%的面積和功率，進一步限制了系統的效率和可擴展性。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種新型FPGA架構，整合了一個無ADC的IMC區塊，用類比內容可尋址記憶體（ACAMs）取代傳統ADC，這些ACAMs在區塊內原生執行非線性運算。為了充分利用這個區塊，我們進行了一次FPGA感知的設計空間探索，確定最佳的交叉開關尺寸，同時平衡FPGA面積、靈活性和DL性能，並開發了一個高效的映射，利用ACAMs執行DIMM運算，將IMC的適用性擴展到注意力計算。在CNN和基於Transformer的基準測試中，所提出的架構分別實現了高達40倍和1.9倍的能量效率提升，以及4.1倍和2.5倍的面積效率提升。總體而言，它顯著提高了FPGA DL推理效率，並在長輸入序列上的Transformer基於工作負載中持續獲得穩健的增益，推進了領域專用FPGA設計。
